verdict.rationale: Rippling's docs say benefits deductions flow automatically into Payroll, and that integrated HSA, FSA and commuter deductions always sync with payroll. That shows the sync mechanism this story needs, but nothing in the evidence mentions a 401(k) or any retirement plan. Missing for 10: any evidence that Rippling offers or administers a 401(k)/retirement plan, retirement contribution (employee/employer match) sync per pay run, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
